limits: Qualification is distinct from whole-service resource acceptance; no controlled ratio to the historical stalled stand.

disk_retention.default: Remove owned SQLite/WAL/SHM/staging/generated CSV after each completed fork, including failures. Preserve inputs/config/logs and complete compressed deduplicated semantic signatures.

memory.scope: Process RSS including startup, not caller allocation/live heap/cgroup charge; affinity 2 CPUs, no private cgroup quota.

excluded_measurements.reason: First pair overlapped PMD; all samples excluded from primary comparison.
WSL relocation left incomplete/truncated evidence; fully rerun separately.
Boot-classpath, source-key oracle and SMB connection-capacity failures fixed before accepted small-7 run; failed-run reports/logs retained.

runtime_manifest_protocol: runtime_files_ref identifies a complete path/SHA256 catalog in runtime_file_manifests; shared catalogs avoid duplicate identity payloads. source_report_sha256 refers to original local reports before this lossless normalization.
